<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break an aryl halide and form a primary amine (the nucleophile in the forward SNAr). This may retrieve the template that, when applied to the product SMILES, yields the exact precursors “COc1ccccc1N” and “Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
